items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A bright, small studio apartment seen wide from the entry: a queen bed with cream linen bedding against the far wall, separated from the living area by an open white oak bookshelf divider about 5 feet tall with books, plants and baskets on the shelves. In front, a compact sage green sofa facing a low TV console, a round jute rug defining the living zone, a small round white oak dining table with two chairs near a large window. Light walls, uncluttered, every zone clearly visible.
